summary: ArchiveXL adds appearances to the vanilla Archer Hella (player record). Each new definition is the factory player_01 definition, read from the local game at build time, plus components that reference vanilla meshes by depot path only.

dynamicAppearance.reason: The vanilla Hella entity has visualTagsSchema = null. ArchiveXL 1.28.0+Open77 handles a .ent patch that adds visual tags to such an entity by assigning an empty handle and writing through it (ResourcePatch/Extension.cpp, visualTags branch): a null dereference on the first load of the entity. The generator refuses that combination. With the tag absent, open77_e06_dyn!a and !b exist only as .app definitions with no .ent entry: the server strings are negative controls.
dynamicAppearance.enableWhen: the ArchiveXL fork creates the schema (Red::MakeHandle<ent::VisualTagsSchema>()) before adding tags; then set entityVisualTags to ["DynamicAppearance"]

appearances.expect: the factory player look plus a junk solar panel on the roof
the factory player look (base of the dynamic set; an ordinary entry while the dynamic tag is disabled)
NEGATIVE CONTROL while the dynamic tag is disabled: no .ent entry, so no change is expected (enabled: solar panel through the dynamic selector)
NEGATIVE CONTROL while the dynamic tag is disabled (enabled: Combat Cab stickers on body and hood through the dynamic selector)
solar panel on the roof, merged from a part .ent by ArchiveXL IncludeAppearanceParts
